source.title: Coffee O'Clock Wall Art | Retro Kitchen Poster | Blue and Red Linocut Illustration | Cafe Decor

analysis.summary: A charming linocut-style illustration of a morning coffee and pastry resting on a table by a sunlit window.
analysis.subject: A blue-patterned ceramic coffee cup and saucer.
analysis.setting: A sun-drenched kitchen table beside a window.
analysis.action: Resting on a tablecloth alongside a flaky pastry.
analysis.style: Linocut print illustration, distressed ink texture, bold outlines, flat color blocks, slight registration shifts, cream paper background.
analysis.composition: Vertical frame with a thin red border; high-angle perspective; balanced asymmetry with a circular text emblem top-left and a window top-right.
analysis.typography: "ITS COFFEE O'CLOCK" in hand-carved, all-caps, sans-serif red lettering within a concentric circular frame.
analysis.audience: Homeowners and renters looking for kitchen or dining room decor with a vintage, artisanal feel.
analysis.hook: The relatable "Coffee O'Clock" mantra paired with a tactile, handmade aesthetic that evokes a slow, peaceful morning.

outputs.title: Tea Time Treat Poster
outputs.brief: A steaming teacup with a floral pattern and a slice of lemon-drizzle cake on a checkered tablecloth. The scene is set by a window showing the silhouette of a potted plant. A red circular emblem in the top-left corner contains the hand-carved text 'TEA TIME TREAT' in all-caps red lettering. Use the original palette of cream, teal, burnt red, and dark navy for outlines. The rendering must feature a distressed linocut texture with grainy ink coverage and slight registration shifts between the color blocks.

outputs.title: Stovetop Moka Morning
outputs.brief: A vintage moka pot sits on a gas stove burner with thick, stylized steam rising in curls toward a rectangular text box at the top. The background features a simple grid pattern suggesting kitchen tiles. The composition is a centered, medium-shot view with a new palette of sage green, terracotta, and mustard yellow on a cream background. The style remains a rough woodblock print with heavy, uneven outlines and flat color application. The text inside the top frame reads 'RISE AND GRIND' in a chunky, hand-cut serif font.

outputs.title: Savor the Slow Breakfast
outputs.brief: A vibrant top-down flat-lay illustration of a breakfast spread including a French press, a bowl of halved strawberries, and a linen napkin. The rendering style moves to a grainy risograph aesthetic with overlapping translucent inks and fine halftone dots. The palette uses electric cobalt blue, bright coral, and lemon yellow on a pale peach background. There is no border or text emblem, focusing instead on the graphic interplay of geometric shapes and textures. Lighting is bright and even, creating a modern and energetic morning atmosphere.
